Let
\[
T_1=\frac{a+b}{c},\quad T_2=\frac{b+c}{d},\quad T_3=\frac{c+d}{a},\quad T_4=\frac{d+a}{b}.
\]
By AM-GM,
\[
a+b\ge 2\sqrt{ab},\quad b+c\ge 2\sqrt{bc},\quad c+d\ge 2\sqrt{cd},\quad d+a\ge 2\sqrt{da}.
\]
Multiplying,
\[
(a+b)(b+c)(c+d)(d+a)\ge 16abcd.
\]
Thus
\[
T_1T_2T_3T_4=\frac{(a+b)(b+c)(c+d)(d+a)}{abcd}\ge 16.
\]
Again by AM-GM,
\[
A=T_1^4+T_2^4+T_3^4+T_4^4
\ge 4(T_1^4T_2^4T_3^4T_4^4)^{1/4}
=4T_1T_2T_3T_4
\ge 64.
\]
Equality occurs at \(a=b=c=d\), so the minimum is
\[
\boxed{64}.
\]
